Staff of Fire & Ice [35 charges]
This strong bluewood staff is ornately inlaid with red orichalcum, creating patterns of flame and ice crystals. A crystal of blue ice is embedded in the wood at one end while a pink tourmaline is held by the metal on the other. This staff can be weilded as a +1 Flaming/+1 Frost quarterstaff. 
Moderate Evocation; CL 10th; Craft Staff, Craft Magic Arms and Armor; cone of cold, mass fire shield, wall of ice, wall of fire, orb of cold, orb of fire, fireball; Price 70,506 gp (new); Weight 4 lb.
Base values, increase for higher level weilder:
>> Cone of Cold - 10d6 Cold Cone, 60ft (DC 17; 1c)
>> Fire Shield, Mass - As Fire Shield (half damage of fire; 1d6+10 Cold to melee attackers; or reverse), 10 rounds, allies within 30ft diameter (DC 17; 2c)
>> Wall of Ice - 10x 10ft squares or 13ft radius hemisphere; DC 25 STR to break through; 30hp; 10in. thick (DC 16; 2c)
>> Wall of Fire - 200 ft fire sheet; 50 ft radius circle; 20ft tall; 2d6+10 fire; 2d4 w/i 10ft; 1d4 w/i 20 (DC 16; 2c)
>> Orb of Cold - 10d6 Cold ranged touch 50ft, no save/SR, Fort DC 16 or blinded for 1r (DC 16; 1c)
>> Orb of Fire - 10d6 Fire ranged touch 50ft, no save/SR, Fort DC 16 or dazed for 1r (DC 16; 1c)
>> Fireball - 10d6 Fire Sphere 20ft radius (DC 14; 1c)
